LanguageData.VGE_OpportunitySite_InfestedAsteroid.que:
questDescription-> [discoveryMethod] the location of an asteroid infested with insectoids. The creatures have carved tunnels into the rock, filling them with debris and salvage from passing wrecks.

The asteroid could hold great value, but the infestation will not be easy to dislodge. You detect clear signs of insectoid activity.

You can reach the asteroid with transport pods, shuttles, or a gravship. Equip your colonists with sufficient orbital apparel before departing.
LanguageData.VGE_OpportunitySite_DormantWarplatform.q:
questDescription->[discoveryMethod] the location of a dormant, automated warplatform. This hostile satellite is filled with anti-air defenses and gauss bombards that will open fire the moment you land.

The platform is heavily defended by security turrets, roaming sentry drones, and hidden mechanical traps. At the center of the installation sits a warcomputer coordinating the network. If your colonists can survive the landing and push through to hack or destroy the warcomputer, the gauss bombards will be permanently disabled, leaving the platform's high-tech salvage for the taking.

You can reach the warplatform with transport pods, shuttles, or a gravship. Equip your colonists with sufficient orbital apparel before departing.
LanguageData.VGE_OpportunitySite_VacstoneMeteor.quest: questDescription->A large meteorite has struck ground nearby. It has left behind a lump of vacstone. Vacstone is required for construction of the more advanced gravship technology. You can send a mining party to retrieve it, but chances are if you wait long enough, someone else will lay claim to it.
Others have mined the Vacstone meteor. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has expired.
LanguageData.VGE_OpportunitySite_DerelictGravship.que: questDescription->[discoveryMethod] the location of a derelict gravship. This ancient hulk, ruined by countless years in orbit, is a trove of salvage, including rare gravlite and advanced components.\n\nThe wreck is currently [threatDescription], making any attempt at recovery a dangerous venture. You can reach the location with transport pods, shuttles, or a gravship. Equip your colonists with sufficient orbital apparel before departing.
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipGraveyard.questDescriptionRu: questDescription->You have detected the distinct energy signature of a gravcore emanating from a massive field of debris: a gravship graveyard. You know that when you arrive, your navigation systems will be locked. An ancient signal jammer is active within the debris field, preventing your gravship from initiating the launch. You must navigate through the field of unstable ancient gravmines, locate the source of the jamming, and neutralize it to escape.\n\nBe careful, orbital locations are extremely dangerous. Equip your colonists with vacsuits. Plan your return trip, as living in orbit for long periods is very difficult.
LanguageData.VGE_InfestedInstallation.questDescriptio: questDescription->You have detected the energy signature of a gravcore. The signal is coming from an abandoned orbital station infested with exoinsectoids. Scans reveal numerous hives on board. You must navigate the infested ruins, defeat the exoinsectoid defenders, and destroy the infested gravlock tether which will continue spawning new exoinsectoids throughout the platform. Once destroyed, you will be able to obtain the gravcore.\n\nBe careful, orbital locations are extremely dangerous. Equip your colonists with vacsuits. Plan your return trip, as living in orbit for long periods is very difficult.
LanguageData.VGE_SalvagerStronghold.questDescriptionR:
questDescription->You have detected the distinct energy signature of a gravcore emanating from a large asteroid. Scans reveal that a well-armed faction of salvagers has claimed the rock, building a heavily defended stronghold upon it. An active enemy signal jammer within the facility prevents your gravship from landing in close proximity, forcing you to touch down on the dangerous outskirts of the asteroid.

You must assault the base, navigate their defenses, and destroy the gravlock tether located in the center of the compound to obtain the gravcore.

Be careful, orbital locations are extremely dangerous. Equip your colonists with vacsuits. Plan your return trip, as living in orbit for long periods is very difficult.
